bridge.line: In a hole beneath the bridge
stanza: You fell from the sky
Crash landed in a field
Near the River Adur
Flowers spring from the ground
Lambs burst from the wombs of their mothers
In a hole beneath the bridge
You convalesced, you fashioned masks of twigs and clay
You cried beneath the dripping trees
Ghost song lodged in the throat of a mermaid

bridge.line: So I stretch myself across like a bridge
stanza: Though dreams can be deceiving
Like faces are to hearts
They serve for sweet relieving
When fantasy and reality lie too far apart
So I stretch myself across like a bridge
And I pull you to the edge

bridge.line: Leaning against the railing of a Lake Charles bridge
stanza: Leaning against the railing of a Lake Charles bridge
Overlooking the river, leaning over the edge
He asked me: Would you jump into the water with me
I told him: No way, baby, that's your own death you see

bridge.line: Harper’s Ferry to the Gauley Bridge
stanza: I have mapped my falling sky
Harper’s Ferry to the Gauley Bridge
Wichita to Omaha and Indianapolis

bridge.line: Summer wasn't bad below the bridge
stanza: Summer wasn't bad below the bridge
A little short on food, that's all
Now I gotta get Marie some kind of coat
We're headed down into fall
I could take a stroll
Sometimes when I'm on my own
I walk down Beale Street
Real nice and slow
Walk up to the river's edge
Get down under the bridge
Highway  over, out
Amongst overhead
I stand all alone in the dark
Pay no mind to the sky full of stars
Try not to think
Just listen to my heart

bridge.songTitle: Killing Me Softly With His Song
bridge.line: Yo, L-Boog, take me to the bridge
stanza: Yo, L-Boog, take me to the bridge
I lost my heart
Under the bridge
To that little girl
So much to me
And now I moan
And now I holler
She'll never know
Just what I found

bridge.songTitle: ’Tis a Pity She Was a Whore
stanza: [Bridge 2]​​
{Bridge}

bridge.line: I passed your ghost on the old north bridge
bridge.lineNext: You was wearing them same far away forever eyes

fridge.line: He talks in maths, he buzzes like a fridge
stanza: Karma police, arrest this man
He talks in maths, he buzzes like a fridge
He's like a detuned radio

ridge.line: Down the back of the ridge
stanza: Mmm, mmm
I will see you off now
Down the back of the ridge
There's just something that I got to show you
There is domer and there's rot
And the common case
It ain't nothing what you say is true

ridge.line: Through the trees on the ridge
stanza: I could see the lights of town
Through the trees on the ridge
On my way home in the dark

ridge.line: Riding in the shadow by the St. Joe Ridge
stanza: Riding in the shadow by the St. Joe Ridge
He heard the click clack tappin' of a blind man's cane
He was pullin' into Baker on a New Year's Eve
With one eye on the pistol and the other on the door
One eye on the pistol and the other on the door
